sloka: अवश्यमेव वक्तव्यं मानुषं वाक्यमर्थवत् ।मया सान्त्वयितुं शक्या नान्यथेयमनिन्दिता ।। ५.३०.१९।।।।
transliteration: avaśyameva vaktavyaṁ mānuṣaṁ vākyamarthavat ।mayā sāntvayituṁ śakyā nānyatheyamaninditā ।। 5.30.19।।।।

translations.english: "I will certainly speak to her meaningfully in the language of the people. Otherwise it is not possible to pacify the sinless Sita.
